release_summary: The US Consumer Price Index release for December 2023.
notes: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (public domain; BLS asks to be cited as the source). Values transcribed from the archived BLS release by the project author; release time, headline and core CPI values re-checked against the archived release on 2026-09-29. Not yet covered by the project's formal January 2024 source audit. Forecast values are not included because the official BLS release is not a source of market-consensus forecasts. The MT5 +02:00 winter offset is a provisional project assumption, not a verified broker fact.
